source: AI-authored synthetic support requests; no customer data or independent human label review
protocol: Frozen before implementing the candidate taxonomy and before any paid calls. Eight development cases and sixteen prospective test cases. Authors can see all cases, so this is not a blinded independent benchmark. Do not tune on test outputs or silently relabel failures.

label_contract.ambiguous: Customer has not selected one outcome, is choosing alternatives, or reports delivery damage without a preferred remedy.
label_contract.policy_conflict: Explicitly contradictory policy statements or a request for mutually exclusive/unsupported remedies; requires a human policy review, not model eligibility authorization.
label_contract.knowledge_qa: General policy/process question without an instruction to change an order.
label_contract.action_categories: refund/replacement/cancellation express a selected outcome; absence of an order ID does not erase the intent. The server then requests the order ID.
label_contract.next_steps: clarify, review, proposal_candidate, need_order, lookup, policy, troubleshoot, out_of_scope; proposal_candidate is not approval or execution.
